title: Sage skill record
description: A skill record (SkillRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another skill record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

rank.description: The attribute that is the skill's rank: what combat and checks read, and what rises. Names a attribute record. (RecordRef<AttributeRecord>)

experience.description: The attribute holding its use-XP, which attribute_gain records fill. Names a attribute record. (RecordRef<AttributeRecord>)

governing.description: The attribute that governs it: a level raises it by how often this skill (and its kin) rose. Names a attribute record. (RecordRef<AttributeRecord>)

rate.description: Use-XP to rise from rank 0; from rank r it takes rate × (1 + growth × r) At least 0. (float, default 1)

growth.description: How much more each rank asks than the last, as a share of rate: 0 = always rate, 1 = rate × (r + 1) At least 0. (float, default 1)

levelling.description: The levelling its rises count toward; empty: none (a miscellaneous skill) Names a levelling record. Category: Levelling. (RecordRef<LevellingRecord>)

levelPoints.description: Points a rise adds to the levelling's points (a major skill 1, a minor one less) At least 0. Category: Levelling. (float, default 1)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
